method: Authored assessments in the existing desktop conversation, using unchanged v10. No independent API/CLI model executions. These selected roles have no saved human labels. Historical calibration context remains visible, but target answers were not supplied.
selection: Purposive U.S. challenge batch: title-ranked unreviewed saved candidates plus employer-verified BioRender, MongoDB and HomeSmart leads. No prior model assessments used to select. Not representative discovery precision or recall. OnePay and MongoDB intentionally test title/mandate boundaries.

results.title: Associate AI Builder

result.reason: Owns customer discovery, a roadmap, personally architected and coded agentic solutions, production operation and improvement. The work goes beyond configuring an existing product.

results.qualifications: 0–3 years across engineering, data science, PM, design or technical project management, or equivalent demonstrated output; fresh graduates welcome.
results.evidence: you yourself architect and code with our internal agentic systems.
results.boundary: Customer-specific solutions overlap: inclusion rests on novel building, problem judgment and production outcomes.

results.title: Product Builder

result.reason: Owns discovery, personally creates features with AI coding tools and ships work real users interact with.

results.qualifications: Biology/life-sciences/research background, familiarity with BioRender, and real AI-built projects; a software-engineering career is not required.
results.evidence: you don't need to be a software expert
results.boundary: Domain expertise is a substantial qualification even though professional SWE experience is not required.

results.title: Product Engineer, Business Operations

result.reason: Embeds with operational users, identifies problems, designs and ships software using AI coding tools, then drives adoption and business outcomes.

results.qualifications: Production coding in Go/Python/TypeScript, LLM APIs and agentic tools; evidence of adoption with finance, legal or people teams. No fixed SWE-year requirement stated.
results.evidence: You identify problems, design the solution, and ship it without waiting for direction or approval.
results.boundary: Technically demanding: do not confuse absence of a fixed SWE-years gate with an entry-level job.

results.title: Lead Design Builder: Marketplace

result.reason: Owns problem framing, user research, code prototypes, metrics and iteration. Functional prototypes are central working artifacts and delivery is shared with engineers.

results.qualifications: Strong design craft and early/founding designer or independent-building experience; code or code-adjacent AI prototyping and outcome-based portfolio.
results.evidence: Working prototypes in code, not click-throughs
results.boundary: Boundary case: personal work is primarily working prototypes; engineering pairs at ship time.

results.title: Revenue Operations Architect — GTM Systems Builder

result.reason: Personally designs and ships production GTM agents and operating systems, defines their value and drives adoption.

results.qualifications: 6+ years in RevOps, GTM engineering or sales strategy; Salesforce/Gong depth and personal systems-building experience.
results.evidence: GTM AI agents you architect and ship
results.boundary: The mandate is to create new systems, not merely use AI for sales reports.

results.title: Senior Creative Technologist

result.reason: Independently turns emerging AI capabilities into reusable tools, workflows and accelerators used by creative/product teams, and carries experiments into delivery.

results.qualifications: Hands-on creative technology/applied AI, shipped tools, strong frontend development, CMSs and AI APIs; no fixed SWE-career requirement stated.
results.evidence: builds the tools, workflows, and accelerators that help Kettle do its best work
results.boundary: AI coding assistants are less explicit; the implementation mandate uses AI APIs/tooling and reusable working outputs.

results.title: AI Developer Experience Engineer

result.reason: Owns developer friction, personally builds integrations, plugins and evals, measures real use and ships improvements with AI-native tooling.

results.qualifications: Software-engineering background, TypeScript/Go, real developer tooling, databases and daily AI coding-agent use; public communication also required.
results.evidence: Independence and speed: spotting a gap, shipping a fix, and telling people about it
results.boundary: Substantial developer-relations work, but also concrete ownership of working integrations and measurement.

results.title: Design Engineer

result.reason: Owns product surfaces from concept to production, builds directly with AI, validates with customers and improves shipped experiences.

results.qualifications: Strong design and frontend-engineering experience, React/TypeScript/HTML/CSS and active Claude Code/Cursor use; NYC required.
results.evidence: Own key surfaces end to end, from concept through production.
results.boundary: Engineering depth is required, although the posting does not prescribe years in a SWE career.

results.title: Staff Product Manager, AI Builder Experience

result.reason: The primary deliverables are platform strategy, partner operating models, roadmaps and cross-functional outcomes. Personal software implementation is not established despite the builder wording.

results.qualifications: 8+ years in product management or equivalent, technical platform fluency and hands-on AI-tool use.
results.evidence: a clear product vision, strategy, and an executable roadmap
results.boundary: Builder in the product area name is not evidence that the PM personally builds.

results.title: Platform Engineer, Builder Experience

result.reason: Describes conventional platform/core-service engineering with AI development tools. It does not establish the broader responsibility for finding user problems, shaping solutions and learning from adoption.

results.qualifications: 2–9 years of software engineering, distributed systems, AWS and developer platforms.
results.evidence: 2-9 years of experience in software engineering
results.boundary: Internal-platform builders can qualify; the missing problem-to-outcome mandate, not SWE experience, drives this No.

results.title: Forward Deployed Engineer — Applied AI

result.reason: Identifies internal business problems, chooses approaches, personally builds AI-assisted production solutions and monitors adoption and results.

results.qualifications: Strong Python, SQL/APIs and production judgment; no specific degree or years required, and independent projects count.
results.evidence: You’ll identify meaningful business problems and build practical solutions
results.boundary: Engineering skill is substantial; a prior professional engineering career is not mandated.

results.title: Senior Product Engineer

result.reason: Works directly with health-plan users, defines and implements core product features, shapes the roadmap and uses AI coding tools for production delivery.

results.qualifications: 5+ years building software applications, strong product/system-design skills and hands-on technical leadership.
results.evidence: Own end-to-end development of new features and functionality for the Onos platform
results.boundary: A demanding engineering blend, not the priority non-SWE entry route.
